scope: All numbered mathematical statements, supporting unnumbered derivations and empirical interpretation reread; no complete formal verification.

claims.label: ass:reach
claims.assessment: Complete short argument added using zero extension and weighted graph energy; failure of reachability gives a nonzero zero-energy vector.

claims.label: lem:decouple
claims.assessment: Direct multiplication proof added; applies because the grounded Laplacian is real symmetric and the delayed gain is scalar.

claims.label: prop:delta1
claims.assessment: Checked all three real-quadratic Schur inequalities and positivity assumptions; strict inequalities exclude marginal roots.

claims.label: thm:main
claims.assessment: Direct-sum argument valid; the unit-disk set is now defined explicitly. General characterization is a reduction, not a new closed-form solution for negative modes.

claims.label: prop:boundary
claims.assessment: Appendix A: increasing phase, increasing crossing modulus, simple unit roots and positive radial derivative imply first complex pair and no stable re-entry. a=0 and negative a are separate cases.

claims.label: lem:cheb
claims.assessment: Appendix B: nonzero continued-fraction denominators; positive derivative of Chebyshev ratio; decreasing first phase angle as integer delay grows. Endpoints separately treated.

claims.label: cor:dose-explicit
claims.claim: Slowest binding mode and hard-pin comparison
claims.assessment: Proof added: monotonicity in a combined with Cauchy interlacing, including preservation of step-size condition.

claims.label: cor:bibo
claims.assessment: Resolvent spectral norm checked; convergence justified by centering the stable recurrence and forcing-norm comparison under coordinate restriction.

claims.label: thm:place
claims.assessment: Appendix D: Neumann-series inverse positivity added; mixed derivative 2 Qij (Q squared)ij is nonnegative; integration gives diminishing returns; finite-k residual-gap recursion checked. Guarantee is only for coherence reduction.

claims.label: thm:twodelay
claims.assessment: Appendix C: real/imaginary linear equations, nonsingular Cramer parametrization, rank-one singular consistency, real-root lines and constant root count off the locus. Does not classify all stable cells.

claims.label: cor:equal
claims.assessment: Small positive gain enters the unit disk; first phase crossing and outward derivative exclude re-entry. Largest grounded eigenvalue binds.

claims.label: rem:absorb
claims.assessment: Unforced monotonic convergence argument and exact forced clipped period-six example valid. Numerical tanh recurrence is no longer called a proved periodic orbit.
